claims.claim: Reported smugglers pair HBM with low-end server processors so export rules score the package on the processor; a December 2024 exemption covered HBM already integrated into logic products.
claims.episode_span: Korean HBM reaching China inside packages that also carry a low-end server processor, so U.S. rules score the package on the processor rather than the memory
claims.source_title: Smugglers Bypass U.S. Controls to Ship HBM to China
claims.supporting_quote: Under U.S. export regulations, the total computing power of a semiconductor package is evaluated based on the server processor, not the memory chip.

claims.claim: One HBM3E is reported at about $4,000, up from a few hundred dollars a year earlier, and six to eight stacks put memory alone at $24,000 to $32,000.
claims.episode_span: one HBM3E, a few hundred dollars a year ago, now trades at about $4,000, and that six to eight stacks on one AI package put memory alone at $24,000 to $32,000.
claims.source_title: Smugglers Bypass U.S. Controls to Ship HBM to China
claims.supporting_quote: A broker in his 20s who handles HBM smuggling in China told The Information that the price of a single HBM3E, which traded for several hundred dollars just a year ago, has recently soared to about $4,000. A single AI chip package requires 6 to 8 HBMs. The memory price alone amounts to $24,000 to $32,000.

claims.episode_span: Huawei told some customers the Ascend 960DT will carry substantial Samsung Electronics and SK hynix HBM, and that Huawei described the chip as twice the performance of existing products.
claims.source_title: Smugglers Melt Solder to Strip Korean HBM for Huawei
claims.supporting_quote: Huawei has said the chip will deliver twice the performance of its existing products and rank among the most powerful processors China can manufacture domestically.
